## Cover letter
We propose vacation rental turnover service agreement for Sample customer at Example property. Please review the scope and service agreement below.

## Scope of service
Service schedule: Per turn.
```veliz_scope_table
{"rows":[{"area":"Dust reachable surfaces","frequency":"Per turn","notes":""},{"area":"Vacuum and mop accessible floors","frequency":"Per turn","notes":""},{"area":"Clean kitchen counters, sink and appliance exteriors","frequency":"Per turn","notes":""},{"area":"Clean bathrooms, fixtures and mirrors","frequency":"Per turn","notes":""},{"area":"Empty ordinary household trash","frequency":"Per turn","notes":""},{"area":"Reset beds with available clean linens","frequency":"Per turn","notes":""},{"area":"Complete departure inspection checklist","frequency":"Per turn","notes":""},{"area":"Document visible damage for the host; no warranty of hidden-damage detection","frequency":"Per turn","notes":""}]}
```

Property: house; 1500 cleanable square feet, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms; vacant.


Turnover window: 11:00 checkout to 16:00 check-in, same day. Expected turns per month: 4. Beds: 3; linen par: 2. Visible damage and photo report within 24 hours after service. 
Ordinary cleaning supplies are included.

### Exclusions
- Regulated, biohazard and mold remediation
- Construction debris and pest remediation
- Exterior or high-access work
- Heavy furniture moving
- Appliance interiors unless selected
- Laundry; host supplies clean linens

### Optional services
- Appliance interiors (count each appliance); agree scope and price before adding work.
- Additional labor after walkthrough review; agree scope and price before adding work.

### Customer responsibilities
- Provide safe access, running water and electricity
- Secure pets and valuables
- Identify delicate surfaces and existing damage
- Approve scope or price changes before work

## Service Quote & Pricing
```veliz_pricing_table
{"rows":[{"service":"Vacation rental turnover service agreement","frequency":"Per turn","pricePerMonth":"$280.00"}],"summary":{"subtotal":"$280.00","tax":"Not assessed","total":"$280.00"}}
```

Your price: $280.00 per turn. Estimated monthly budget: $1120.00; actual billing depends on visits completed. Confirm actual billing schedule in writing.

Taxes are not assessed in this estimate; confirm applicability before acceptance.

## Terms & Conditions
This is a per-turn service agreement. Each turn must be booked and confirmed; same-day capacity is subject to the agreed window and linen availability. Host supplies consumables and spare linens. Report lost property and visible damage promptly; no hidden-damage inspection is included.
